entities.summary: Jokhow Panom "JT" Thor is a South Sudanese American professional basketball player for Pallacanestro Reggiana of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Auburn Tigers and was selected by the Detroit Pistons with the 37th overall pick in the 2021 NBA draft.
